verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a server product, so a buyer can fairly ask whether it ships a machine-readable API spec, and the axis applies. Probes of all candidate OpenAPI/Swagger paths returned 404. The llms.txt file found is a docs index, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
